title: Parameterized Complexity of $L_p$-Lipschitz Constants for Input Convex Neural Networks and $L_p$-Norm Maximization over Zonotopes
abstract: arXiv:2608.24865v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lipschitz constants are a standard way to quantify the sensitivity of neural networks to small input perturbations, but computing them is difficult even for shallow ReLU networks. We study this problem for two-layer input-convex neural networks (ICNNs), a restricted architecture where nonnegative output weights enforce convexity. Computing the $L_p$-Lipschitz constant for these networks is equivalent to maximizing the dual norm over a zonotope. While $L_1$- and $L_\infty$-norm maximization on zonotopes admit fixed-parameter and polynomial-time algorithms, respectively, the parameterized complexity of the remaining $L_p$-norms was open. We prove that, for every fixed $p\in (1,\infty)\cap \mathbb{Q}$, maximizing the $L_p$-norm over a zonotope in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is W[1]-hard with respect to the dimension $d$. Moreover, our hardness results imply that brute-force enumeration algorithms are essentially optimal for this problem under the Expo

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24865v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：Lipschitz常数是量化神经网络对小输入扰动敏感性的标准方法，但即使对于浅层ReLU网络，计算它也相当困难。我们研究了双层输入凸神经网络（ICNNs）的这一问题，这是一种受限架构，其中非负输出权重强制凸性。计算这些网络的$L_p$-Lipschitz常数等同于在zonotope上最大化对偶范数。虽然zonotope上的$L_1$-和$L_\infty$-范数最大化分别允许固定参数和多时间算法，但其余$L_p$-范数的参数化复杂度此前是开放的。我们证明，对于每个固定的$p\in (1,\infty)\cap \mathbb{Q}$，在$\mathbb{R}^d$中的zonotope上最大化$L_p$-范数是关于维度$d$的W[1]-难问题。此外，我们的难度结果暗示，在指数时间假设下，暴力枚举算法对于此问题本质上是最优的。
tldr: 本文证明了对于所有固定有理数$p\in(1,\infty)$，在zonotope上最大化$L_p$-范数是W[1]-难的，从而解决了输入凸神经网络Lipschitz常数计算的参数化复杂度开放问题，并表明暴力枚举算法在指数时间假设下是最优的。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that maximizing the $L_p$-norm over zonotopes is W[1]-hard for every fixed rational $p\in(1,\infty)$, resolving the parameterized complexity of Lipschitz constant computation for input-convex neural networks and showing brute-force enumeration is essentially optimal under ETH.
